pages: Refrigerant Transition Changes: Air Handlers, Coils, Air Conditioners, and Heat Pumps SEPTEMBER 2024 In alignment with the Low GWP Refrigerant Transition, American Standard Heating and Air Conditioning and Ameristar by American Standard are pleased to continue the R-454B refrigerant products launch. For your reference, the models on this document support the various launches of products which will include the 15 SEER2 Heat Pumps. This document will be updated as more R-454B products are released. COILS The Coils product family will undergo several changes to support the transition to R-454B refrigerant. In our commitment to safety of our products, a Refrigerant Detection System (RDS) will be added which contains a leak detection sensor and mitigation control board mounted to the coil. There will be a new factory supplied wire harness running between the RDS (in the coil) and furnace, requiring field connection. Coil nomenclatures will reflect a 1st, 9th, and 14th digit change in the model number, with some models seeing 6th, 7th, and 8th digit changes as well.
